method: Correctness reconstructed from official EWoK gold and existing prediction JSONs; no margins/logits stored in predictions.

interpretation.what_this_can_say: Counts item-level flips and metadata concentration of treatment-by-seed interaction on existing official predictions.
interpretation.what_this_cannot_say: Does not measure confidence/margins; for that, rerun or instrument the official scorer around compute_results.py all_log_probs/rank_and_evaluate.
